summary: handover_equality.py now scopes an app by its `<app>-<stage>-` namespace, and takes an interface through its instance link or its Assignment to one of the app's own services. It lists each relation drawn outside the app under the producer that draws it: a Serving edge's consumer, otherwise its source. The comparison moved into handover(), and 11 fixture tests cover it (ArgoCDTools ce5efb9 on phase/025-P3; kc project test and lint green). The non-Serving ownership rule goes beyond the plan's text and is logged as close-out Q2.
